draft_frames.purpose: 跨分镜保持一致的人物外观锚点
draft_frames.prompt: Pure person reference image, focused only on a single performer's appearance for cross-shot identity consistency. Show one non-identifiable young adult woman (early 20s), slim build, long loose wavy dark hair, dark low-saturation gothic makeup with subtle smoky eyes, wearing a unified dark gothic outfit family of dark top and long dark coat, silver-grey metal rings, layered dark bracelets and a dark wide-brim hat; mysterious, refined, slightly eerie temperament matching dark gothic nail art. Neutral standing pose, front-facing, full upper body, plain dark studio background, soft low-key lighting. Do not include any product, nail art, readable text, logo or identifiable real person. Realistic photography, vertical 9:16 framing.
must_include: 年龄印象：20 代年轻女性
体型：纤细，以手部与局部面部入画
发型：深色长发，松散微卷，夜风中轻摆
妆容：深色系、低饱和、轻微烟熏，强调眼部轮廓
服装：统一的暗黑/哥特装扮家族——深色上衣、深色长外套，避免参考视频的白色露肩上衣与米色风衣
配饰：银/灰金属戒指、层叠深色手镯、深色宽檐帽
气质：神秘、精致、略带诡异感，与目标美甲风格一致
身份约束：非可识别表演者，不复用参考视频人物身份，不生成真实可识别面孔
可见差异锚点：相对参考视频的明亮休闲装扮，改为深色哥特长外套＋宽檐帽＋暗色金属配饰
notes: 外观来自生成假设 ga_002/ga_003（深色哥特装扮与场景），已包含 visible_difference_anchor

draft_frames.purpose: 跨分镜保持一致的场景外观锚点
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference image, focused only on an interior location for video background consistency, no people and no product. A dark gothic indoor dressing room: antique vanity mirror with carved frame, deep velvet curtains, candle holders, dark dried flowers, dark walls; low-key candlelight as key light with cool window rim light, rich shadow detail; charcoal, dark wine red, dark teal and dark gold palette; velvet, dark wood, antique brass and stone materials; medium-dark background density, shallow depth of field, private mysterious gothic mood. No readable text, logo or watermark. Realistic photography, vertical 9:16 framing.
must_include: 空间类型：室内化妆间/闺房，承接参考视频的室内开场功能
前中后景：前景为人物双手，中景为人物上半身，背景为深色墙面与古董梳妆镜
陈设：古董梳妆镜、深色天鹅绒帷幔、烛台、深色干花、雕花镜框
光线：低调烛光为主光＋冷色窗光轮廓，暗部层次丰富
色调：炭黑、暗酒红、暗青、暗金
材质：天鹅绒、深色木、古董黄铜、石材
背景密度：中等偏暗，主体突出
景深：浅景深，背景柔和虚化
氛围：私密、神秘、哥特
可见差异锚点：相对参考视频的普通门框室内，改为深色哥特化妆间，加入古董镜/烛台/深色帷幔等陈设锚点
notes: 外观来自生成假设 ga_002/ga_003（深色哥特装扮与场景），已包含 visible_difference_anchor

draft_frames.purpose: 跨分镜保持一致的场景外观锚点
draft_frames.prompt: Pure scene reference image, focused only on an outdoor location for video background consistency, no people and no product. A moonlit gothic stone garden: dark stone walls, wrought-iron gate, ivy, wet stone ground, dark reflective pool, dark dried flowers and black roses; cold moonlight as key light with small warm lantern accents, low-key rich shadow detail; deep teal night, charcoal stone, dark green and silver highlights; wet stone, old iron, moss and dark fabric materials; medium-high dark background density with spatial depth, shallow depth of field, mysterious cinematic gothic mood. No readable text, logo or watermark. Realistic photography, vertical 9:16 framing.
must_include: 空间类型：户外月夜石庭/花园，承接参考视频的户外展示与收尾空间
前中后景：前景为手部/人物，中景为人物，背景为深色石墙、铁艺门与常春藤
陈设：深色石墙、铁艺门、常春藤、湿石地面、暗色反射水池、深色干花/黑玫瑰
光线：冷月光为主＋局部暖色灯盏，低调光、暗部层次丰富
色调：深青夜色、炭灰石材、暗绿、银色高光
材质：湿石、旧铁、苔藓、暗色织物
背景密度：中高偏暗，具有一定空间纵深
景深：浅景深，人物与手部清晰、环境虚化
氛围：神秘、电影化、哥特
可见差异锚点：相对参考视频的明亮草地/湖泊/蓝天白云/绿色山坡，改为月夜哥特石庭，色板由蓝绿高明度改为深青/炭灰/暗绿低明度
notes: 外观来自生成假设 ga_002/ga_003（深色哥特装扮与场景），已包含 visible_difference_anchor

consistency_review.global_style_brief: 统一暗黑哥特低调影调：低饱和暗色高对比（炭黑/暗褐/暗青/暗金），低调光深阴影＋局部高光，写实生活方式摄影质感、轻微胶片颗粒，中焦/中长焦浅景深、手机竖屏拍摄感，暗黑哥特编辑风（gothic editorial）。
global_negative_constraints: no readable text, logo, price, watermark, corner mark or UI
no identifiable real person or reference-video person identity
no reference-video brand or source-specific props
no blue-and-white reference nail pattern (target is dark gothic eyeball nail art)
notes: 1 个人物实体 → 1 张 person_reference；2 个明显不同的场景实体 → 2 张 scene_reference
